node.title: XR deficient window: common-ray eliminant payment
node.statement: On an m-dimensional active-defect affine slice, a fixed (m+1)-tuple of pairwise distinct phi values belongs to one selected block for at most m+1 target parameters. Introducing the common error ray turns the block conditions into m+1 affine-linear equations in m parameters with coefficients linear in the ray. Generic consistency would create a varying-ray component, forbidden by the distinct-pole argument; a nonzero rank minor of degree at most m+1 therefore contains every admissible ray, and the same-ray strip leaves one target per root. At the full next dimensions this improves the ell=1 payment through d+1=8500560263 at rates 1/4,1/8 and d+1=4265559234 at rate 1/16.
